title: API keys for your organization
summary: Organization API keys in Settings, a privacy consent step at sign-up, a Pricing link in the sidebar, and cleaner term base and glossary CSV imports.

items.title: Create API keys for your organization.
items.body: The new **Settings → API keys** page lets you create, list and revoke keys for AI agents, scripts and integrations. A key always acts in the organization it was made in.

items.title: New accounts agree to the privacy policy.
items.body: Signing up with email, Google or Microsoft now shows a consent checkbox, unticked by default, and the account is only created once it is ticked. The Sign in page shows it too, since signing in with a new email creates an account.

items.title: A Pricing item in the sidebar
items.body: opens Credits, where plans and top-ups live. It sits above Support.

items.title: Term base and glossary CSV imports garbled Hindi and other Indic text.
items.body: Files saved as UTF-8 without a byte-order mark were read with the wrong encoding. They now import correctly.

items.title: Term base CSV imports changed some cells.
items.body: Values such as 01/02 were turned into dates, and cells starting with = dropped the row. Cells are now imported exactly as written.

items.title: Social sign-in buttons could stay busy
items.body: after a failed or abandoned redirect. They reset when you come back to the page.
